entry.title: Comfy Agent Beta: VFX, Marketing & E-Commerce Workflows

media:group.media:title: Comfy Agent Beta: VFX, Marketing & E-Commerce Workflows
media:group.media:description:
Comfy Agent is entering beta, and we're opening the door! Join us live as the team behind it walks through what the agent actually does on the canvas and the story of how it got built.
Comfy Agent doesn't sit off to the side handing you instructions. It builds, runs, and edits real workflows on the graph, working alongside you rather than in place of you. We'll show that live, including an agent-optimized VFX workflow and a product SKU example generating a full batch of on-brand marketing shots.
We'll also get into how it's different from running your own agent through Comfy MCP using Claude, Cursor, etc.
What we'll cover: 🤖 What Comfy Agent is, shown live on the canvas 🤖 Comfy Agent demos for different use cases (VFX, marketing/e-commerce) 🤖 How this differs from bringing your own agent via Comfy MCP 🤖 How to get beta access, and what the free tier covers
Join the beta: https://links.comfy.org/agentbeta
⏰ Subscribe and enable notifications to catch the stream live 💬 Submit your questions in chat during the broadcast or before the stream in the comments! 👍 Leave a like if you'd like to see more on agent-driven workflows!
